cause_quote: The diff moved `for (const listener of listeners) { listener(); }` out of the `syncThemePaletteStylesheet` callback, so a deferred download notified subscribers before `applyThemePresentation(settings)` ran.
user_saw: An already-open MCP app kept the previous colors after the Control UI finished switching themes, until the app resized or reopened.
summary: The fix notifies subscribers when a deferred theme palette is applied, while keeping preference notifications immediate and synchronous updates to a single notification.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #136362 and confirmed that mounted MCP apps already subscribed to theme updates and read the host's computed colors after the palette was applied. The diff in #136362 moved the notification ahead of deferred palette application, leaving the app with the old colors. The later mascot and hat change restored a completion notification only when those branding fields changed.
